title: DOAH 26-0060PIC Order: LIANNE ROBAINA vs. CORPORATION
text:
STATE OF FLORIDA
DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS
OSMANY CRUZ DE LA FE AND
LIANNE ROBAINA,
Petitioners,
vs. Case No. 26-0060PIC
CITIZENS PROPERTY INSURANCE
CORPORATION,
Respondent.
/
ARBITRATION AWARD
Petitioners, who are insured by Respondent Citizens Property Insurance
Corporation ("Citizens"), submitted an insurance claim for a date of loss of
February 24, 2025. Citizens assigned it claim number 001-00-607222. After
Citizens denied the claim, Petitioners disputed that claim determination, and
Citizens demanded in January 2026 that the dispute be arbitrated at the
Division of Administrative Hearings. The matter was assigned to the
undersigned, and an arbitration hearing was scheduled for March 24, 2026.
This is an arbitration, not a chapter 120 administrative proceeding. By
the parties' agreement and operation of law, this arbitration is mandatory,
binding, and irrevocable. §§ 682.013(1), 682.02(1), Fla. Stat. The Order of
Pre-Hearing Instructions informed the parties that "[i]f notified that
Petitioner has withdrawn his or her insurance claim, the undersigned will
conclude this proceeding by entering an arbitration award stating that the
amount owed on the claim is zero dollars."
On March 24, 2026, at the start of the arbitration hearing, Petitioners
stated on the record (through counsel) that they desired to withdraw, and no

longer pursue, this insurance claim. Citizens stated on the record (through
counsel) that they agreed not seek attorneys' fees and costs against
Petitioners. Petitioners acknowledged (through counsel) that they understood
this meant Citizens would make no payment on this insurance claim, and
this arbitration proceeding would be concluded by entry of an arbitration
award.
Accordingly, the amount of policy benefits payable on claim number 001-
00-607222 is zero dollars.
DONE AND ORDERED this 24th day of March, 2026, in Tallahassee,
Leon County, Florida.
